# aap_workflow_job_template_notification_template_error (Resource)

Associate notification template(s) to a workflow job template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aap_workflow_job_template_notification_template_error" "example" {
  workflow_job_template_id = 100
  notif_template_ids       = [1, 2]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `notif_template_ids` (Set of Number) An unordered list of `Automation Controller_notification_template` IDs associated to a particular Workflow Job Template.
- `workflow_job_template_id` (String) The ID of the containing Workflow Job Template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import aap_workflow_job_template_notification_template_error.example 100
```
